cmd.module.maker: Make a new game module with your AI agent: install commands, a first prompt, and this PC's paths
cmd.config.export: Save settings and the server list to a zip, to move to another PC (game files not included)
cmd.config.import: Bring in settings and servers from an export zip
cmd.bot.channels: Talking Saba-chan channels (several) and the music channel (one) of a paired Discord server. No options: show
cmd.monitor: CPU, memory, disk and network use, and each server's share
cmd.audit: Who started, stopped or sent commands to servers, and from where (GUI, CLI, Discord, schedule)
cmd.perm: Who may run which commands from Discord (levels per member, preset, overrides)
cmd.perm.show: Levels, preset and overrides of one Discord server
cmd.perm.commands: Commands per level: from which level each command can be used (one server with --server)
cmd.perm.grant: Give a member a level: admin, user, chatbot or banned
cmd.perm.revoke: Take a member's own level away (they get the default level)
cmd.perm.default: Level for members without their own level
cmd.perm.preset: Command level preset: loose, default or strict
cmd.perm.cap: Highest level a request through Talking Saba-chan can use
cmd.perm.command: Level one command needs (`<server id>/<command>`); leave the level out to go back to the preset
cmd.perm.owner: Change the pinned owner of this Discord server
cmd.perm.level: Add, rename, remove or move a permission level of one Discord server (`perm show` lists them)
cmd.perm.level.add: Add a level (right below the owner, or right above `--above`)
cmd.perm.level.remove: Remove a level: its members move one level down, commands that needed it one level up
cmd.perm.level.move: Put a level right above another one (the owner stays on top, banned at the bottom)
cmd.sandbox: Isolated runs of unverified modules and extensions
cmd.sandbox.allow: Run this component without isolation when isolation cannot be prepared (asked again when its files change)
cmd.sandbox.revoke: Remove the consent to run without isolation
cmd.do: Run any daemon action by id (`saba-chan-cli do` alone lists them)
cmd.bot.lang: The language the bot answers in on a Discord server (`auto` follows this PC's language). No value: show
cmd.bot.sleep: Put the bot to sleep on a Discord server (it ignores commands until woken)
cmd.bot.wake: Wake the bot on a Discord server
cmd.bot.music: Music player settings of a Discord server. No options: show
cmd.bot.allow: Servers a Discord server can see and run. No servers: show. `--all`: every server
cmd.bot.link: Connection requests sent from Discord with /saba connect and no code. No id: show, ID: accept, `--decline`: refuse
cmd.help: Show help for a command. With --json: the command tree, arguments and exit codes
cmd.events: Follow daemon events as they happen (with --json: one JSON per line). Ctrl+C to stop
cmd.install: Install Saba-chan on this PC without the window installer
cmd.uninstall: Remove Saba-chan from this PC (settings and servers are kept unless removed)
cmd.config.paths: Where Saba-chan keeps its data, modules and extensions, and the default folders
cmd.config.move: Move modules or extensions to another folder. Installed files are moved; servers must be stopped
cmd.server.discord: What Discord chat calls this server and its commands (the same in every Discord server). No options: show
cmd.gui: Switch to the desktop app: it opens on the same server and the full-screen menu closes
cmd.config.autostart: What starts when you sign in to this PC: off, daemon (daemon and tray only) or full (with the GUI window). Shows the current value without a mode
cmd.config.browse: Folders and files on the daemon's PC (with --daemon, the remote PC). Drives or / without a path
cmd.server.port-check: Check whether friends can reach this server from the internet (port forwarding)
cmd.bot.notice: Post in the Discord server's alert channel when Saba-chan starts a server (off by default). No server: show. Server with `--on`/`--off`: change
cmd.bot.confirm: When the bot asks with a Discord button before running (all, caution, danger, none). No options: show

help.after:
Names can be partial (e.g. start pal). Run with no arguments in a terminal to open the full-screen menu (SABA_NO_TUI=1: the interactive shell).
In scripts use --json and --yes. Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 failed · 2 usage · 3 daemon unreachable · 4 not found · 130 cancelled

restart.confirm: Stop and start '{{name}}' again? Connected players will be dropped for a moment.

backup.confirm_delete: Delete backup {{backup}} of {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
backup.confirm_restore: Put {{name}} back to backup {{backup}}? The current world is saved as a backup first.
backup.confirm_restore_running: {{name}} is running. Stop it and put it back to backup {{backup}}? The current world is saved as a backup first.
backup.pre_restore: The world from before is kept as backup {{backup}}.
backup.links_not_restored: The restore finished, but {{count}} link(s) inside the folder could not be recreated (Windows permissions, for example). The daemon log lists the paths.
backup.unreadable_hint: {{count}} backup(s) cannot be opened. They cannot be restored, and unused backup content is not cleaned up until they are deleted. Delete them.
backup.unreadable_restore: Backup {{backup}} cannot be opened, so it cannot be restored. Delete it.

schedule.bad_action: "{{got}}" is not a task. Use one of: {{actions}}.

schedule.no_save: This game has no save command.
schedule.command_required: A game command needs --command (list: server commands).

schedule.bad_weekday: "{{got}}" is not a weekday. Use one of: {{days}}.

schedule.bad_arg: "{{got}}" is not an input. Use NAME=VALUE.
schedule.confirm_danger: {{command}} is hard to undo, and it runs at the set time without asking. Schedule it?

monitor.network_note: Disk IO and network are whole-machine values, not split by server. Bars scale to the peak seen while watching. Per-server IO requests include cache hits, so they exceed real disk IO.
monitor.disk_io_process_note: Physical disk counters unavailable; showing the sum of process IO (includes cache hits).

tui.question: Confirm
tui.help:
←→↑↓  move the way the screen is laid out (tabs → list → buttons → console)
Tab / Shift+Tab  next / previous area
Enter  press a button (… fills the command line for you, ▾ opens more)
1-6  jump to a page
Server console  press ↓ to get there, type, Enter sends it to the server (↑↓ history)
: or /  command line (what you'd write after saba-chan-cli, Tab completes, ↑↓ history)
F2  open or close the output,  PgUp/PgDn, mouse wheel  scroll
F9  switch to the GUI (when it can open)
Ctrl+C  stop the running command,  Esc  step back
q  quit (the daemon and servers keep running)
tui.too_narrow: Make the window at least 60 columns wide.
tui.not_here: This command can't run inside the full-screen menu. Quit with q and run it in the terminal.
tui.needs_terminal: The full-screen menu needs a terminal. In scripts, use the subcommands.

discord.pair_hint: Press [Pair] to connect to Discord. The code shows in the console.

hint.closed: Check that your router forwards this port to this PC and that the PC firewall allows it.
hint.firewall: Windows Firewall is blocking incoming connections on this port. For the network you are connected to now (private or public), allow saba-core if the server is stopped, or the game server program if it is running, in Windows Firewall settings, then check again.
